name: droverstatus
description: Local web dashboard for drover corrals, agents and tasks
author: Ferenyl

scripts.dev: bash -c 'export PORT=${PORT:-4187}; if (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$PORT) 2>/dev/null; then echo "port $PORT already in use" >&2; exit 1; fi; trap "trap - INT TERM EXIT; kill 0" INT TERM EXIT; npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web & wait -n'
scripts.start: [ -d web/dist ] || npm run build; npm start -w server
